messages:
ella (Billing): FYI — AuroraGrid flagged INV-2026-1155 for duplicate charge. They see two $3,200 line items for the same month. Customer sent a dispute asking for immediate refund of the duplicate or a credit memo. They also said treasury will only release payment once dispute is resolved.
omar (Collections): If it's a true duplicate we can issue a credit memo, but credit memos > $1k need Finance sign-off. Option A: issue partial refund for the duplicate ($3,200) and collect remaining $3,200; Option B: apply a credit memo and accept staged payment for remaining balance. Which do we prefer to avoid churn?
ella (Billing): Gateway shows two settled captures for the same invoice date. Could be connector duplicate. I can pull the settlement IDs. Customer prefers a refund (wire) since they want cleared funds to match AP records.
suzie (FinOps): Refund wire ok but we need to confirm refund policy and check if reversal affects revenue recognition. If we do refund, record GL reversal 4102 and notify RevOps. Alternatively, credit memo keeps revenue in ledger but offsets receivable. Refund needs CFO ok given amount > $1k.
carmen (Legal): Also confirm contract terms re: disputes and refund windows. If it's our error, we should expedite. If it's a customer-side duplicate submission, require them to sign a dispute withdrawal before refunding.
ella (Billing): I propose a hybrid: issue a provisional credit memo for $3,200 to unlock service and allow treasury to pay the undisputed $3,200. Simultaneously request a signed dispute confirmation from the customer that they will accept either a refund or credit memo after we complete reconciliation. If they insist on wire refund, route to FinOps/CFO for approval.
omar (Collections): Hybrid sounds good. To reduce risk, require two things: 1) signed dispute form, 2) treasury confirmation to pay outstanding $3,200 today. If signed form not received in 72h, revert credit memo and resume collections.
ar-ops-bot: System note: invoice INV-2026-1155 status set to "dispute_pending" by ella (Billing) at 2177777800.
suzie (FinOps): Approve provisional credit memo up to $3,200 contingent on signed dispute withdrawal or acceptance form + payment of undisputed amount. If customer requests wire refund, escalate to CFO (cfo-approval required). Tag GL: 4204-CREDIT-MEMO.
carmen (Legal): I'll draft a short dispute confirmation template and add the acceptance options (credit memo vs refund) + 72h window. Send to customer for signature.
ella (Billing): I'll attach settlement IDs and post the provisional credit. Omar please prepare payment plan note and set follow-up reminders.
omar (Collections): On it. I'll set reminders and draft escalation rules if the customer misses the 72h window. Also recommend blocking auto-retry until dispute resolved to avoid double-collection.
suzie (FinOps): Please put the provisional credit and the customer concession in this week's AR memo so leadership sees potential revenue impact.
ella (Billing): Customer just replied: treasury will pay the undisputed $3,200 today if we apply the credit memo so they can reconcile. They signed the dispute form digitally and selected credit memo (not refund).
suzie (FinOps): Great — proceed. Once payment posts, apply credit memo and close dispute. Finance will handle GL entries. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
